findings.conclusion: All three amendments are constitutive: ordered substitution itself changes the law on issuance; no separate factual act of typesetting, appointment of all permitted members, or completed administrative handover is a condition of amendment efficacy. Do not code immediate whole-order exhaustion.

Council existence/functions end through 1999-06-30 inclusive on the latest express §4(b) term; exclusive reading ends when that day begins. Earlier extension occurrence is supported by official charter/history, subject to exact retention and review.

Parent §4(b) limits Council existence; it does not say whole EO12852 expires. Parent §4(c) revoked EO12737 independently. Revoking EO12852 does not itself reestablish that earlier commission. No stand-alone EO12737 lifecycle adjudication is made.

EO13138 expressly recites completed work and terminated committees. It corroborates termination by September30 but cannot alone supply an earlier exact operational date. Fixed Council term plus extensions supply June30, without inferring report performance from a deadline.

owner_rule.quote:
When a later order strikes words from a clause and inserts replacement text, or restates a
section "to read as follows", the clause continues, amended, until the parent order ends. The
amendment is a `later_event`, and that event records the clause text before and after.
owner_rule.application: Separates constitutive amendment execution from continuation of amended provision. A later numeric/date replacement is an event, not a first ending.
